title: SIDS Fell To 0.64 Deaths Per Thousand Babies
hook: SIDS fell to 0.64 deaths per thousand babies.
closing: Putting babies on their backs remains a simple habit that protects sleeping infants.
question: Would you share this with parents?

segments.say: SIDS fell to 0.64 deaths per thousand babies, showing a simple sleep change cut risk dramatically.
85.4% of cases involved stomach-down sleep, revealing why changing position mattered so much.
About 3,400 sleep-related infant deaths still occur yearly, so safer sleep advice remains urgent.
